summary: Independent review found that the proposed repair still permits the legacy PeerLite Gate to consume future-conditioned M3 market columns, incorrectly treats PIT VERIFY as a positive training gate, lacks an external RunAuthority grant, and relies on verifier self-attestation for replay. The genesis archive-proof schema also remains incomplete.

limitations: Read-only design review; no production, test, contract, ledger, server, training, or final-OOS mutation.

blockers: M7 derived-contract freeze, real M7 fit, CCC/Gate experiments, and final OOS remain prohibited until the design defects are resolved and re-reviewed.
